newsitem.title: USA: Nortech sees imaging profit in early '97.
newsitem.headline: Nortech sees imaging profit in early '97.

text.p: Nortech Systems Inc said on Friday that development costs hurt results at its imaging technologies products business in the third quarter, but it expects the division to achieve profitability in early 1997.
Chairman Quent Finkelson also expects Zercom Corp, which Nortech acquired on November 4, to positively contribute to earnings in 1997.
Zercom complements Nortech's existing capabilities, allowing the company to pursue higher-level assembly business -- including sophisticated electronics -- from existing and new customers.

Nortech, which manufactures wire harneses, cable assemblies and electromechanical assemblies for the defense and commercial industries, late Thursday reported third-quarter earnings of $0.09 per share, unchanged from the year-earlier quarter. Sales rose to $6.1 million from $5.4 million.
